text:
maria: Quick update, I ran the APAC bench for the new 40B q4f16 build across H100 and A100. Observed median H100 latency ~220ms but p99 jumps to ~560ms during small microbursts. We need a sizing call for Dedicated APAC pools — current plan (20 H100s) won't hit p99 < 400ms at our target concurrency.

tom: Can you share the concurrency profile? what's the request size distribution? :eyes:

maria: TL;DR: workload median len=128, 95th len=512, steady qps mostly in 40-70 qps but microbursts to 220 qps for 60s windows. Concurrency target per GPU we're using in sims was `8` for H100 with fused-attn-v2 kernels. With that, headroom needed ~20-30%.

priya: FWIW our A100 runs have slightly smoother p99 due to kernel fallback (fused-attn-v1) but higher median cost. A100 p99 ~480ms at same concurrency, cost per token ~+12% vs H100. We should consider mixed-pool fallback to A100 for cost vs latency tradeoffs.

kai: From ops sims: to keep p99 <400ms under observed burst profile we need either increase pool to 24 H100s ( +20% ) or reduce target_concurrency_per_gpu to 6 (which reduces throughput capacity). Both options affect committed capacity/cost differently.

maria: Proposal: add 4 H100s to APAC pool, keep target_concurrency=8, and add autoscale headroom to cover 90s microbursts. Draft autoscale snippet:
```
autoscale:
  min_replicas: 20
  max_replicas: 30
  target_concurrency_per_gpu: 8
  scale_up_window_s: 90
  headroom_percent: 25
```

priya: Suggestion: instead of immediate +4 H100, try hybrid: reserve +2 H100 (24 total) and enable cross-region fallback to EU (A100) for non-SLA customers. That keeps committed spend lower and gives fast fallback.

maria: Good idea. Can we simulate fallback routing cost and estimated p99 impact if ~15% traffic is overflowed to EU? Tom, can you run a sim with routing policy `latency-first` for premium, `cost-first` for non-premium and overflow TTL 45s?

tom: On it. I'll run a 24-node APAC + cross-region overflow sim. Expect results in ~45min. Will attach the latency/throughput charts.

ops-bot: deploy-alert: APAC pool autoscaler triggered scale-up +3 replicas at 2026-03-20T10:14:30Z for observed burst. Current replicas: 23 -> 26 :rocket:

kai: Noted. Once tom posts sims let's pick one of: (A) +4 H100 committed, (B) +2 H100 + EU overflow, (C) keep 20 and reduce target concurrency to 6. Need rough monthly delta for each.

priya: I'll calc delta cost vs SLO hit rate for B and C, aim to post numbers within the hour. Also will run quick quant-kernel sweep to see if swapping kernels reduces p99 without adding GPUs.

maria: Thanks all. Priority: keep premium p99 < 400ms. Follow-ups: tom posts sims, priya posts cost deltas, kai to update runbook with chosen option and rollback plan. :thumbsup:
